description: This file implements the Shutdown class for the 'generic' task namespace, which manages stopping a worker thread in a media player component.

classes.name: Shutdown
classes.description: A class responsible for executing the shutdown process by stopping the worker thread of the media player.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Shutdown object with a reference to the player.

methods.name: ~Shutdown
methods.description: Destructor that logs the shutdown completion.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the shutdown operation by stopping the worker thread.
